li.label: everyone seems fine
li.description: Nothing much going on. People are getting on with it.

li.label: a bit of an atmosphere
li.description: One or two of them are having a hard week. I can tell because they keep saying so.

li.label: everyone is struggling except me
li.description: Something has gone wrong with all of them at once. They sit about not eating.\n\nI slept fine.

li.label: the place is coming apart
li.description: They are barely functioning. Crying in the corridor, forgetting to eat, taking three days to do a morning's work.\n\nI have never felt better. I do not know what that says about me and I am not going to think about it.

li.label: somebody has to keep this place running
li.description: Every single one of them is in pieces. The whole colony is held together by me, because I am the only one it has not touched.\n\nIt is the best I have felt in years.

li.label: somebody here is untouched by it
li.description: The rest of us are wrecked and they are exactly the same as they were before it happened. Eating properly. Sleeping.\n\nI cannot work out whether I envy them or whether it frightens me.

li.label: glad it was them and not me
